item.title: Version 1.12
item.description:
What's New in 1.12

  • Second Draft now runs on the newest AI models: Claude Sonnet 5.5, GPT-6.1 Sol, and Gemini 3.8 Flash. You're switched over automatically, nothing to change in Settings.
  • Claude rewrites are tuned for quality. In our testing, suggestions came out noticeably better without getting any slower.
  • More models to pick from in Settings: Claude Opus 5.5 and Haiku 5.5, GPT-6 Luna and GPT-6 Astra, and Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite. The model menu now shows just the current lineup, no retired models.
  • Fixed: OpenAI's newest models showed an error instead of suggestions. They work now.
  • Safer API keys: if you paste a Claude key into the OpenAI field by mistake, Second Draft catches it and never sends it to OpenAI.
  • Your app version now shows in Settings → General, so it's easy to tell us which build you're on when you report something.
  • Second Draft is now part of Zentropic, our new studio. Nothing changes for you: same app, same privacy.
